description: Branch-relative numeric exception ledger for docs/opsiq/ux/OWNER_FEATURE_PRESERVATION_BASELINE.json. The accepted preservation baseline is now current main 0ecbd34518152685148a7d389e6201a1cca9d80c, and there are currently NO active branch-relative numeric exceptions (entries is empty). An entry records a numeric leaf field (ownerPageRoutes[].componentTreeFileCount, cockpitExternalFeeds[].callSiteCount, businessContextClassificationCounts.*) for which a branch's committed baseline value legitimately differs from the accepted main value because of that branch's OWN source changes: expectedBranchValue = acceptedMainValue + branchDelta, with acceptedMainSha naming the main commit the accepted value was read from. Rules: main-only drift never belongs here; every recorded branchDelta must be non-zero (zero-delta entries are deliberately omitted); each path appears once. A future branch may add entries only for genuine non-zero branch-owned deltas, and must remove them once it merges and the baseline is re-anchored. src/__tests__/governance/preservation-relative-delta.test.ts enforces these invariants for whatever entries are present; an empty ledger is a valid governed state. The history of the earlier entries is in git.
